title: Check voting-power delegation and DRep input

summary.text: Voting-power delegation asks for a wallet and registration type. The form validates a DRep identifier when that choice needs one.

problem.text: Vote DRep governance invalid DRep ID not enough funds

symptoms.text: Vote DRep governance invalid DRep ID not enough funds

user_phrases.text: Vote DRep governance invalid DRep ID not enough funds

daedalus.notes: Interface source inspected at Daedalus 11.0.0. Later versions and specific OS releases require another review; safety advice is Ariadne editorial policy.

causes.claim: A symptom alone does not establish a cause.

resolutions.action: Select the intended wallet and voting registration type.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: For a DRep choice, verify the intended identifier before submitting. If the form rejects it, recheck the identifier rather than substituting an arbitrary one.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: Review the proposed transaction before approving it. If an insufficient-funds or initialization error persists, contact support.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

expected_outcome.text: You can distinguish invalid input from a funds or transaction-initialization error. This is not a Catalyst registration guide or a guarantee of voting eligibility.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, private keys or spending passwords.
Do not delete, reset or move wallet data using generic instructions.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

prerequisites: Use the genuine application and keep private backups private.
consequences: Changing or approving wallet operations can affect funds.
recovery: Stop if unsure; contact human support before changing wallet data.

evidence.rationale: Official source inspection and Ariadne safety review; not wallet runtime testing.

faq.reason: Conservative source-reviewed introduction; not an exhaustive troubleshooting procedure.
